title: Code and derived data for: Radiomics and deep learning for muscle-invasive bladder cancer on MRI: how much survives leakage-free validation?
description: Analysis code (Python), analysis plan (written before model training), derived tables, out-of-fold predictions, figures and manuscript sources for a leakage-aware benchmark of T2-weighted MRI radiomics and deep learning for predicting muscle invasion in bladder cancer on the public FedBCa dataset (Zenodo 10409145). No images are redistributed.
